notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible.
description:
Give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Broodhatch Nantuko triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Insect creature tokens equal to the damage dealt.
When the Insect(s) enters the battlefield, Halana triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Repeat from step 4.
